findings.desc: concept-cleanup: absolute-cwd assumption only partially migrated to portable v2 semantics. buildDoneRequiredCommandSpecEnvelope (commandSpec.cwd, CHK-002) now digests a repo-relative logical cwd, but validateRequiredReceiptCoverage (done-required-validation.ts ~L546-551) still compares the top-level DoneRequiredCommandReceipt.cwd field (an absolute physical path recorded at run time, set at line ~640 to result.cwd ?? commandCwd(runTimeProjectRoot, command.cwd)) against normalizedCommandCwd(CURRENT projectRoot, command.cwd). When done-required-evidence.json recorded in one worktree/host is evaluated (evaluateDoneRequiredEvidence, called at DONE-gate time) against a different worktree/host root -- exactly the scenario this story title promises to fix -- this produces a spurious receipt-cwd-mismatch reason and fails DONE evaluation, even though the fixed commandSpec digest would correctly match. Reproduced directly: validateRequiredReceiptCoverage(evidence, rootA, [cmd]) -> [] but validateRequiredReceiptCoverage(evidence, rootB, [cmd]) -> ["receipt-cwd-mismatch[0]: expected <rootB>, got <rootA>"] for the identical receipt. The same root-cause pattern also affects isPackagesMainBuild/validateSelfHostBuildProof (same file, ~L414-419), which classifies a receipt as a packages/main build proof by comparing receipt.cwd against rootCwd/packagesMain derived from the CURRENT projectRoot, so cross-root build-proof matching can also silently fail unless the command config sets providesBuildProof. Neither code path is covered by the new worktree-portability-smoke.ts (all its evaluateDoneRequiredEvidence-adjacent checks use a single root; only the nested commandSpec digest and the lock path are exercised cross-root), so this residual absolute-cwd comparison has no regression coverage.
